input: Pitch my short film idea to producers

gold.taskTitle: Pitch My Short Film Idea to Producers
gold.taskDescription: Prepare and deliver a compelling pitch for an original short film concept to potential producers.

questions.title: What is the core genre and theme of your film?
questions.description: Understanding the genre (thriller, drama, comedy, etc.) and central theme shapes the entire pitch angle.

questions.title: Do you already have a written script or treatment?
questions.description: Knowing whether a script, outline, or just a raw idea exists determines how much development work is needed before pitching.

questions.title: Have you identified specific producers you want to target?
questions.description: Whether the user has a shortlist of producers or needs to find them affects the research and outreach steps required.

questions.title: Will you pitch in person, via email, or at a festival?
questions.description: The pitch format (live meeting, written deck, festival pitch session) determines what materials need to be prepared.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for making this pitch?
questions.description: A specific date or event deadline helps prioritize and sequence all preparation tasks appropriately.

questions.title: What is the estimated budget range for your short film?
questions.description: Producers immediately think about budget viability, so having a figure in mind is critical to a credible pitch.

questions.title: Do you have any cast, crew, or visual materials attached?
questions.description: Knowing if there are mood boards, a director attached, or committed talent helps gauge how polished the pitch package currently is.
